endDialog.title: End this encounter?
endDialog.body: Ends the fight and writes each character combatant's HP, temp HP, and death state back to their sheets. You can Reopen later to resume where combat left off. If sheets heal or rest after this End, Reopen will show the conflict and ask which HP to keep — it will not silently overwrite.

reopenDialog.title: Reopen this encounter?
reopenDialog.body: It returns to Running where combat left off. Character sheets were synced when it ended — if a sheet has healed, rested, or otherwise changed since then, choose which HP to keep before reopening.
reopenDialog.noConflicts: No sheet HP conflicts — combatant snapshots still match the sheets.

actions.attack: Make one weapon or unarmed strike against a target in range. A class feature like Extra Attack can grant more than one.
actions.dash: Gain extra movement equal to your speed for this turn.
actions.dodge: Until your next turn, any attack roll against you has disadvantage if you can see the attacker, and you have advantage on Dexterity saving throws.
actions.disengage: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of this turn.
actions.help: Grant an ally advantage on their next ability check to complete a task, or set up their next melee attack against a creature within 5 feet of you.
actions.hide: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check to try to hide, becoming unseen by creatures that fail to spot you.
actions.ready: Choose a trigger and an action or movement to take in response to it, using your reaction when the trigger occurs.
actions.search: Devote your attention to finding something, usually with a Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check.
actions.use: Interact with a second object or feature of the environment beyond the one free interaction you already get on your turn.

conditions.blinded: Can't see and automatically fails any check that requires sight. Attack rolls against the creature have advantage, and its own attack rolls have disadvantage.
conditions.charmed: Can't attack the charmer or target it with harmful abilities or magic, and the charmer has advantage on social checks against it.
conditions.deafened: Can't hear and automatically fails any check that requires hearing.
conditions.exhaustion: A cumulative penalty track from level 1 to 6 — each level worsens ability checks, speed, and more, and reaching level 6 is fatal.
conditions.frightened: Has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of its fear is within line of sight, and can't willingly move closer to it.
conditions.grappled: Speed becomes 0 and can't benefit from any speed bonus; ends if the grappler is incapacitated or the creature is removed from its reach.
conditions.invisible: Impossible to see without special senses, and heavily obscured for hiding purposes. Attack rolls against it have disadvantage, and its own attack rolls have advantage.
conditions.paralyzed: Incapacitated and can't move or speak, and automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attacks against it have advantage, and any hit from within 5 feet is a critical hit.
conditions.petrified: Transformed, along with any nonmagical items it's wearing or carrying, into a solid substance; incapacitated, and resistant to all damage and immune to poison and disease.
conditions.poisoned: Has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
conditions.prone: Can only crawl unless it stands up. Has disadvantage on attack rolls; melee attacks against it have advantage, and ranged attacks against it have disadvantage.
conditions.restrained: Speed becomes 0. Attack rolls against it have advantage, its own attack rolls have disadvantage, and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saves.
conditions.stunned: Incapacitated, can't move, and can speak only falteringly; automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves, and attacks against it have advantage.
conditions.unconscious: Incapacitated, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings. Drops what it's holding and falls prone; attacks against it have advantage, and any hit from within 5 feet is a critical hit.
